title: The Tortoise and the Hare
moral: Keep going, step by step, and you can reach places you never thought you could; and a kind friend cheers for you whether you win or lose.
how_to: Every prompt in prompt_manifest.json is a template rendered from this file by production/image_prompts.py --story tortoise_and_hare_v1 (build, lint, show, md, review). Character identities are design specs until each canonical image is approved; then rewrite them from the image (hex sampled from it) and rebuild.

hattie.name: Hattie
hattie.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
hattie.identity: Hattie is one tall, slim young wool-felt hare who stands, walks and runs upright on two long hind legs. Her body felt is warm caramel-tan (#C9955B), with a lighter wheat-beige mask around the eyes (#E2BE8A), a long oval cream belly and chest (#F3E3C6) and one small round white cotton tail (#FAF6EE) at the lower back. Two very long upright ears, each as long as her head and neck together, with dusty-pink inner felt (#E8A3A0) and dark chocolate-brown tips (#4E3426). Her oval head has a short rounded muzzle with two cream muzzle pads (#F5E8D2), a small rose-brown nose (#A86A5E), a small mouth line and four fine pale whiskers (#F0E2CC) on each side. Two large almond-shaped glossy eyes, each about a fifth of the head width: amber-brown irises (#8A5A22), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4ECE4). Two short dark-brown brows (#5A3A22). Two slim arms with small rounded paws; two long hind feet with three toes each, each foot about as long as her shin. Her ears make up about two fifths of her height from feet to ear tips; her head is about one sixth. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
hattie.sheet: one tall slim caramel-tan felt hare standing upright, very long ears with pink insides and chocolate-brown tips, cream belly, two amber-brown eyes, a rose-brown nose and one small round white tail
hattie.short: Hattie is one tall slim caramel-tan felt hare standing upright, very long ears with pink insides and chocolate-brown tips, cream belly, two amber-brown eyes, a rose-brown nose and one small round white tail.
hattie.mouth: When Hattie's mouth opens, it is a small rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior, a soft pink tongue and two small ivory upper front teeth just showing.
checklist: one hare standing upright, two arms, two long hind feet
two very long upright ears with pink insides and chocolate-brown tips
caramel-tan body with a lighter wheat-beige eye mask
one small round white cotton tail
two almond eyes with amber-brown irises and ivory sclera
four pale whiskers on each side
three toes on each long hind foot
ears about two fifths of her height
colours not shifted by scene light

toby.name: Toby
toby.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
toby.identity: Toby is one small, rounded young wool-felt tortoise who walks on four short sturdy legs. His high domed shell is warm olive-green felt (#7A8B3C) divided into large honey-tan hexagonal plates (#C9A15A), each outlined with darker olive-green stitching (#55652A), with a narrow cream-yellow rim (#E6D49A) along the lower edge of the shell. His head, neck, legs and short pointed tail are soft sage-green felt (#A9B97A); his chin and throat are pale cream (#EEEACB). His round head is about one third as long as his shell, with a short blunt snout, two tiny dark nostril dots and a gentle wide mouth line. Two large round glossy eyes, each about a quarter of the head width: warm dark-brown irises (#5A3A22), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F2EEE2), softly rounded upper lids that make him look calm. Two short soft olive-green brows (#55652A). Four short legs with three rounded cream toenails each (#EFE6CF). He has no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothing. His shell is about 1.6 times as long as he is tall at the shell top, and his head sits out in front on a short neck. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
toby.sheet: one small rounded olive-green felt tortoise with a domed shell of honey-tan hexagonal plates, sage-green head and legs, cream chin, two brown eyes, four short legs and a short pointed tail
toby.short: Toby is one small rounded olive-green felt tortoise with a domed shell of honey-tan hexagonal plates, sage-green head and legs, cream chin, two brown eyes, four short legs and a short pointed tail.
toby.mouth: When Toby's mouth opens, it is a small rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and a soft pink tongue; he has no teeth.
checklist: one tortoise, four legs, one short pointed tail
domed olive-green shell with large honey-tan hexagonal plates
darker olive stitching around every plate
two eyes with warm dark-brown irises and ivory sclera
no ears, no hair, no teeth
head about one third of the shell length
colours not shifted by scene light

olive.name: Olive
olive.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
olive.identity: Olive is one small, round, wise wool-felt tawny owl who stands upright on two feet. Her body feathers are warm tawny-brown felt (#9A6A3C) with small cream speckles (#EAD9B8), and her round chest is lighter buff-cream (#E3CBA0) with soft brown chevron stitches. Her round face is a pale buff-cream disc (#E8D2A8) edged with a thin chocolate-brown rim (#5A3A22), with two short soft feather tufts on top of the head. Two very large round glossy eyes, each about a third of the face width: golden-amber irises (#D69A2A), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera only at the edges (#F4ECE0); two small chocolate-brown brow feathers above them; a small hooked dark-brown beak (#4A3426) between and below the eyes. Two folded wings with darker brown bars (#6E4A2A), and two short feet with three ochre-tan toes each (#C9A15A). She is about as wide as she is tall, without the tufts. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
olive.sheet: one small round tawny-brown felt owl with cream speckles, a buff-cream face disc, two big golden-amber eyes, a small brown beak and two folded wings
olive.short: Olive is one small round tawny-brown felt owl with cream speckles, a buff-cream face disc, two big golden-amber eyes, a small brown beak and two folded wings.
olive.mouth: When Olive speaks, her small hooked beak opens slightly to show a dark warm-brown inside; she has no teeth and no lips.
checklist: one owl, two folded wings, two feet
buff-cream round face disc with a thin brown rim
two short feather tufts on the head
two big eyes with golden-amber irises
colours not shifted by scene light

pip.name: Pip
pip.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
pip.identity: Pip is one small, quick young wool-felt red squirrel who stands upright on two hind feet. His body felt is warm rust-orange (#B5562A), with a cream belly and chest (#F1DFC2) and one big bushy tail (#C2622E) that curls up behind him almost as tall as he is. Two small rounded ears with short darker rust-orange tips (#8E3F1E). His round head has a short muzzle with cream cheeks (#F1DFC2), a tiny dark-brown nose (#4A2E22), a small mouth line and three fine pale whiskers (#F0E2CC) on each side. Two large round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#4A2E22), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F2EEE2); two short dark-brown brows. Two small arms with tiny paws and two hind feet with four toes each. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

pip.short: Pip is one small rust-orange felt squirrel with a cream belly, a big bushy curled tail, small rounded ears and two dark-brown eyes.
pip.mouth: When Pip's mouth opens, it is a tiny rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and two small ivory front teeth.
checklist: rust-orange body, cream belly and cheeks

bramble.name: Bramble
bramble.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
bramble.identity: Bramble is one small, round, cosy young wool-felt hedgehog who walks on four short legs and can stand up on two. His back is covered with soft rounded felt spines in chestnut-brown (#6E4A30) with cream tips (#EADBC0), like a round brush; they are soft and friendly, never sharp. His face, tummy and legs are pale biscuit-beige felt (#E7CBA4). His pointed little snout ends in a round black nose (#2A1E18). Two small round ears (#D8B88E). Two small round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light, ivory sclera (#F2EEE2); two short brown brows. A small smiling mouth line. Four short legs with tiny paws. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

meadow_morning.label: the sunny meadow in morning light
meadow_morning.description: A sunny felt meadow at the edge of a wood: a wide flat lane of short green grass fills the lower half, with clumps of white daisies; a mossy tree stump stands at the left; a line of small round grey pebbles crosses the grass as the start line; the forest path opens between two trees at the far right; rounded felt trees and a soft blue sky behind.

the mossy stump at the left (x 0.08-0.22, top near y=0.55)
the pebble start line across the grass (y 0.80-0.83, x 0.25-0.70)
daisy clumps at the lower right and lower left corners
the grass lane where characters stand (y 0.70-0.90)
meadow_morning.light: Fresh morning sunlight from the upper left; soft shadows to the right.
meadow_morning.ambient: Grass tips and daisies sway gently in a light breeze; leaves flutter; the stump, trees and pebbles stay fixed.

blocks.style: Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable.
blocks.runtime_style: Handcrafted matte wool-felt stop-motion miniature, tactile fibres and stitching, softly lit, sharp readable subjects.
blocks.light_and_colour: Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it.
blocks.final_check: Before finishing, check: each visible character appears exactly once, with exactly two eyes and two eyebrows (one above each eye, drawn once), its canonical ears, limbs, wings and toes, whiskers only where its canonical has them and exactly one tail attached at its root; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere.
blocks.edit_end_frame: This is an edit of the accepted start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position exactly; change only what this frame shows below.
blocks.edit_reference: Edit the first attached reference, the approved parent image: keep the character's identity, colours, brightness and proportions exactly; change only the view or pose stated here.
blocks.edit_expression: Edit the first attached reference, the approved closed-mouth portrait: keep its crop, head size and position, every feature, colour, the felt texture, the whiskers, the backdrop and the light exactly; change only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth.
blocks.studio_full_body: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side.
blocks.studio_portrait: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, with no room, furniture, floor or horizon, and soft even neutral light; head-and-shoulders crop with the whole head, both ears and any mane inside the frame with a small margin; the head keeps the size and eye-line of the approved closed-mouth portrait.
blocks.plate_rules: Empty plate: no characters and no story props. Normal-height camera, the whole scene edge to edge, open in-focus ground where characters will stand, distant background slightly soft. Every landmark keeps the position stated above; a different light state of this place reuses exactly the same geometry.
blocks.cast_scale: Relative size (fixed for the whole story, the same at the same distance from the camera): Hattie standing, from feet to ear tips, is the tallest; Toby's shell top reaches about one third of Hattie's height and his shell is about half her height long; Olive standing is about two fifths of Hattie's height; Pip standing, to his ear tips, is about one third of Hattie's height, his tail reaching about half; Bramble is about one quarter of Hattie's height. Sitting, lying or running changes a silhouette but never the size of a head, shell, ear or limb.
blocks.studio_lineup: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, soft even neutral light, one flat ground line at y=0.88 where every character stands, with a small soft contact shadow under each; every whole body, every ear tip, foot and tail inside the frame with a margin.
blocks.ribbon_object: The finish ribbon: one daisy chain of small white felt daisies with yellow centres on a thin green felt stem, tied between the two finish sticks at about two thirds of their height.
blocks.ribbon_tied: The finish ribbon: one daisy chain of small white felt daisies with yellow centres on a thin green felt stem, tied between the two finish sticks at about two thirds of their height. It hangs across the path, whole and unbroken.
blocks.ribbon_parted: The finish ribbon: one daisy chain of small white felt daisies with yellow centres on a thin green felt stem, tied between the two finish sticks at about two thirds of their height. It has just parted in the middle where Toby walked through; its two halves hang from the sticks.
blocks.ribbon_down: The finish ribbon: one daisy chain of small white felt daisies with yellow centres on a thin green felt stem, tied between the two finish sticks at about two thirds of their height. Its two parted halves hang from the sticks after Toby walked through it.

reference_roles.edit_base: the edit base ({what}): keep everything in it (camera, crop, background, light, every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position) except what this prompt changes
reference_roles.identity_root: {who}'s approved canonical image: copy {who}'s identity exactly, with the same shapes, proportions, colours and brightness
reference_roles.locked_plate: the locked location plate ({what}): reproduce this background exactly, with the same landmarks, light and camera
reference_roles.world_state: the previous accepted frame ({what}): carry over the world state (props, damage, contacts and positions) unless this prompt changes it; use the framing stated in this prompt
reference_roles.camera_geometry: camera and layout reference ({what}): copy only the camera position and the layout of the place; take no character or prop state from it
reference_roles.expression: expression reference ({what}): copy only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth shape onto {who}'s canonical face
reference_roles.pose: pose reference ({what}): copy only {who}'s body pose and proportions, not the background
reference_roles.prop: prop reference ({what}): copy the prop's material, colour, shape and size; its state in this frame is the one stated in this prompt
reference_roles.mouth_design: mouth design reference ({what}): copy only the mouth opening, the teeth and their size
reference_roles.staging_only: older-version staging reference ({what}): copy only the composition, camera and staging; every character's look comes from the canonical images
reference_roles.size_anchor: size anchor ({what}): an approved frame of this same camera setup; every character keeps exactly the size it has there, and takes no pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.framing: framing reference ({what}): copy only the shot size, where the head sits in the frame and how strongly the background is blurred; take no character, background, light or expression from it
reference_roles.size_lineup: the story's size lineup ({what}): copy only the size relation between Leo and Milo, applied at the sizes stated in this prompt; take no camera, background, pose, expression or prop state from it
